brief: Montenegro's sr-language business-media layer is small, concentrated and genuinely additive: Bankar.me is the only specialised banking outlet and its interview and conference sections are where bank executives and CBCG officials name systems, platforms and suppliers, while MINA Business is the agency wire that timestamps announcements first and Investitor.me and eKapija ME add analytic and deal-shaped, semi-structured coverage. The general dailies and portals (Vijesti, Pobjeda, Dan, CdM, Portal Analitika, RTCG) form a corroboration tier that reliably captures infrastructure milestones — SEPA accession, the July 2026 TIPS Clone instant-payments launch across all eleven banks, the 2025-2029 FinTech Strategy — but rarely attributes vendors, and several of them republish bank PR verbatim, so duplicate detection is required before treating multi-site coverage as independent confirmation. Two practical constraints shape collection: Bankar.me returned a 403 to automated fetching and needs a browser-style collector rather than being written off as dead, and eKapija's premium tender and company data sits behind a commercial ToS that favours a subscription over scraping. The main open gaps are direct confirmation of vijesti.me's structure, an inventory of domestic integrators beyond Logate, and bank LinkedIn pages as a likely faster-than-press channel for go-live and partnership signals.
